label: build F2 3/4
result:
F2 unit 3 is built and committed on `v2/f2`, and the branch is detached so it's free. `test_flow` prints "all good" on the branch and also with master's server code plus my files. Browser checks at 1280 and 390, in light and dark, showed no console errors. For "what should I tell my other guy": the list under "Needed from other owners" is the message.

**What I built**
- **Banners (`ui.js`)**: retired, offline (retries at 5, 10, 20, then every 30 s, with Retry now) and storage blocked were already there from units 1–2, and I checked them in the browser. Added, one at a time in the spec's order:
  - registration deadline (U17), e.g. "Register for Nov 7 by Oct 23 · 5 days left", with I've registered, College Board and Add to calendar;
  - stage change on its first day (U15), with Why? and Keep my settings;
  - first visit, with Sign in and Dismiss;
  - the save nudge at 50 answers, where Not now hides it for 7 days.
- **Event toasts**: achievements and report replies. At most 2 per page load, each shown once per tab, then marked seen.
- **Parser**: `UI.ALIASES` sits beside TOPICS. `UI.parseSet()` turns "circles hard 5 timed" into a drill body (skills, counts, endless, tiers, adaptive, timed, mc/grid, pools, "15 min" time boxes).
- **`palette.js`**: every group in the spec (the composed set on top, commands such as "target 700", "exam dec 5", "timer off", "dark" and "set 22" with an Undo toast, skills with Tab sub-actions, 386 question types, named mistakes, pages, actions, settings, help), plus Suggested and Recent when empty. Keyboard and phone layout work.
- **`quick.js`**, three tabs (R29):
  - Quick question: live tally, 5/15/30-minute time boxes, Save, Another on Enter or N, Practise {skill}. Closing with 0 answers leaves no session; with 1 answer it shows in history as "Quick questions" and never as Resume.
  - Log a mistake (U2): find the question by College Board ID (an unknown ID falls back to pasted text or a skill), by pasted text, or by a few words. The picked letter names the mistake. After adding, the sheet shows the trap in an example, Try one now and Practise 3. A whole-test mode has two 22-question grids.
  - Add a word: hands off to Words.
- **`qr.js`**: the MIT QR encoder (qrcode-generator 1.4.4), unchanged. Its codes decode correctly with OpenCV, non-Latin text included. Also the Continue on your phone sheet.
- **`api_shell.py`**:
  - `GET /api/shell/catalog`: a slimmed type catalogue, 53 KB gzipped against 700 KB for `/api/types`.
  - `/api/shell.has`: flags which other sections' routes and files exist, so the shell never calls something that would 404.
  - An adapter for F6's reports hook.
- `checks/f2.py` covers the new server keys.
- The F1 view-transition follow-up in `head.js` was already done in unit 1.

**Commits:** d6cdea2, a437047, 30b55fd, dd616e4, 47d50c9, e72431b, 55613bf, 3c209b3, 5a8c251

**Needed from other owners**
- **F1**:
  - kit's banner order has no `deadline` or `stage`. I work around it by showing only one notice at a time.
  - `UI.toast` doesn't wait until a prerendered page is shown, as U23 asks. I wrap mine.
  - Buttons have no option to open a link in a new tab. I used `window.open`.
- **F5**:
  - `/api/types` has no `cb {known, bank}` and no gzip. My catalogue reads the private `api_bank._official`.
  - 127 types share 32 names (nine are called "Equivalent expressions"). I show each type's own line under the name to tell them apart.
  - `box` is accepted but nothing uses it yet.
  - `/api/types/match/pick` ignores `value` for grid-ins.
  - `/api/outside/misses` and `/api/mistakes/import` don't exist. Whole-test mode falls back to 2 questions per missed skill.
- **F6**: rename `reports.shell(learner)` to `shell_part(learner, tz)`. Its `newest_report` key clashes with Results' newest sitting; my adapter renames it to `report`. The quick sheet's Report button is hidden until `report.js` exists.
- **F3**: the quick sheet calls `UI.workspace(host, q, {mode: 'inline', onCheck → Promise of the answer result})`, then `select`/`choose` and `focus`. It loads `question.js` itself when that file exists; until then it uses the old `UI.question`.
- **S1**:
  - Endpoints the shell calls: `/api/pair` with status/allow/deny, `/api/share`, `/api/me/export`, and `/api/me/achievements/seen` taking `{ids}`.
  - Achievements should arrive as `{id, tier, name, glyph?}`.
  - `/help/answers.json` as `[{id, q, a}]`.
  - The `go=` parameter on `/pair/`.
  - The passkey "Save with Face ID" in the save nudge (it currently links to `/me/settings/#account`).
- **S3**: `POST /api/scores {day, math, source: 'bluebook'} → {id}`.
- **S9**: `UI.addWord(word or {text})` in `words-ui.js`.
- **`next.py`** (listed as F2's in shell-me but not in my files): until it exists, Suggested and the closing "Next:" toast use fallbacks.

**Not built in this unit**
- The auto-opening welcome-back and week sheets (U25).
- The pace line on target commands, which needs S7.
- "Bring many at once" (U2).
- R&W fields in whole-test mode.

**For unit 4:** acceptance items 11–13 passed in my Playwright scripts, but those scripts are in the scratchpad, not the repo. `parseSet` has no self-check in the repo yet.

**Branch base:** `v2/f2` branches from an older master and lacks F5's routes, so Log a mistake degrades on the branch's own server. I tested against master's server code with my files swapped in.
